'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• O-A2.1 — Reliability Orchestration
  Owner: maintenance_manager
  Trigger: ops.availability.pct < 88.0%
  Impact: High
  Expected: 2.0–6.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained availability deterioration for this asset
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant reliability driver (MTBF, MTTR, PM, Parts) for this asset
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this asset
  ⚠ Trigger only if unplanned downtime is the dominant availability loss driver
  ⚠ Do not trigger if availability loss is driven by production scheduling

• O-A2.2 — Failure Reduction (MTBF Improvement)
  Owner: reliability_engineer
  Trigger: ops.mtbf.hours < 0.2%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: 10.0–30.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify assets with declining MTBF
  · Analyse dominant failure modes
  · Execute corrective and preventive actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if PM compliance is within acceptable range
  ⚠ Do not trigger if failures are dominated by external events

• O-A2.3 — Repair Time Reduction (MTTR Control)
  Owner: maintenance_supervisor
  Trigger: ops.mttr.hours > 0.25%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: -10.0–-30.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify assets with prolonged repair times
  · Analyse repair steps and waiting times
  · Standardise tools, spares, and procedures
  ⚠ Trigger only if safety incident rate remains within tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if MTTR increase is driven by spare parts stockouts

• O-A2.4 — Preventive Maintenance Discipline
  Owner: maintenance_planner
  Trigger: ops.pm_compliance.pct < 90.0%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: 5.0–10.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify assets with declining PM compliance
  · Analyse backlog causes and capacity constraints
  · Rebalance PM schedule and resources
  ⚠ Trigger only if PM backlog is structural, not one-off
  ⚠ Do not trigger if PM deferrals are approved by operations leadership

• O-A2.5 — Spare Parts Readiness
  Owner: maintenance_supply_coordinator
  Trigger: ops.spare_parts.stockout.pct > 10.0%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: -5.0–-15.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · Identify assets impacted by spare part stockouts
  · Classify missing parts by criticality and lead time
  · Correct stocking levels or secure alternative sourcing
  ⚠ Trigger only if MTTR impact is observable
  ⚠ Do not trigger if stockouts are caused by approved supplier shutdowns'
